content:
[Last week, Apple filed a lawsuit against OpenAI, accusing its former employees of stealing trade secrets 'for the benefit of OpenAI.']

[It is reported that Apple has directly sent letters to dozens of former employees currently working at OpenAI during this process.]

[According to the Financial Times, Apple has issued litigation hold notices to approximately 40 former employees.]

[A litigation hold notice is a formal written notification sent to an individual or organisation, requiring them to preserve documents, records, and other evidence that may be relevant to a legal dispute. Such notices typically specify what should be preserved.]

[This move suggests that Apple suspects the theft of trade secrets may involve more individuals than those named in the initial lawsuit filed last week.]

[As a reminder, Apple's lawsuit names OpenAI and io Products as defendants, and also targets former Apple employees Chang Liu and Tang Tan.]
